title: Gneiss Earth
description: Adds 7 stone variants to fill out the underground
body:
![Waterfall on top of new stone variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/da7a5eba1d76da8f7735bda0483c073dd229671d_0.webp)


## **New Stone Variants:**

- Amphibole — a dark, dense igneous mineral
- Gabbro — a coarse-grained intrusive rock
- Olivine — a green silicate mineral found in the deep
underground
- Feldspar — one of the most abundant minerals in Earth's
crust
- Mica — a layered silicate with a distinctive sheen
- Kaolinite — a soft clay mineral
- Talc — the softest of the new stones

![New stone in cave](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f865b5075573d48de8fd52a7eee076296e18445a_0.webp)

![New stone in cave](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/52d161f0c4cdca3763a41cbd674eca6e984953e5_0.webp)

## **Building blocks:**

- Raw stone block
- Bricks
- Brick Stairs
- Brick Slabs

![Building blocks from new stone variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/24b24a9d7fd9eb78c4d56ec60c8e1bcc54f2817f_0.webp)

## **No inventory clutter!**
